verdict.rationale: Superhuman explicitly documents 'split inbox' functionality with custom categories like VIP, Notifications, Calendar, and Team, plus custom Auto Labels that let users organize incoming mail into tabs by type so triage happens by focus area rather than arrival order. This is a first-party documented feature with a dedicated blog post, not just a vague claim. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the split-inbox feature specifically (community evidence covers other aspects of Superhuman but not this feature) and detail on how priority ordering interacts with arrival order within each stream.
